type.description: Indicates what kind of material or resource it is.

values.tool: Software or framework used in the IC design process.
values.doc: Official or community documentation describing tools or methodologies.
values.tutorial: Step-by-step learning resource, article, or lab guide.
values.project: Design, SoC, or chip project that demonstrates an implementation.
values.pdk: Process Design Kit defining device models and design rules.
values.community: Organization, forum, or collective that promotes open-source IC design.
values.video: Recorded lecture, workshop, or explanatory video.

workflow_stage.description: Specifies where the resource fits in the RTL-to-GDSII design flow.

values.installation: Setting up tools, PDKs, and environment configurations.
values.specs: System or circuit specification and initial design intent.
values.simulation: Behavioral or functional validation of RTL or schematics.
values.synthesis: Conversion of RTL to a gate-level netlist using logic synthesis.
values.floorplanning: Defining the chip outline, core area, and macro placement.
values.placement: Placing standard cells while meeting timing and congestion goals.
values.cts: Clock Tree Synthesis — distributing the clock signal with minimal skew.
values.routing: Global and detailed routing of interconnections between cells.
values.extraction: Parasitic RC extraction for accurate timing and signal analysis.
values.sta: Static Timing Analysis to verify timing constraints after routing.
values.drc: Design Rule Check to verify layout compliance with PDK rules.
values.lvs: Layout vs. Schematic verification to ensure logical equivalence.
values.gds: Final GDSII export ready for fabrication.
values.signoff: Final set of verification steps for manufacturability approval.
values.integration: Combining analog and digital blocks in a mixed-signal top level.
values.verilog: Writing RTL code in Verilog or SystemVerilog.

topics.description: Main technical focus or domain of the material.

values.digital: Covers digital circuits and implementation flows.
values.analog: Covers analog or continuous-time circuits and their design.
values.mixed-signal: Combines analog and digital domains (e.g., ADCs, PMICs).
values.education: Focused on teaching methods, workshops, and learning resources.

format.description: Indicates the form or medium of the resource.

values.pdf: Static document such as a paper, lecture note, or report.
values.repo: Source code or design files hosted in a version-controlled repository.
values.slides: Presentation slides or visual learning materials.

audience.description: Defines the intended audience or experience level.

values.beginner: New to IC design or open-source tools.
values.intermediate: Has prior experience with basic design and simulation.
values.advanced: Capable of complex implementation and optimization flows.
values.instructor: Teaching or guiding others in IC design.

license.description: Indicates the licensing model or usage rights of the resource.

values.MIT: Permissive open-source license commonly used in software projects.
values.GPL: Copyleft license requiring derivative works to remain open-source.
values.Apache-2.0: Permissive license with patent protection clauses.
values.CC-BY-SA: Creative Commons license requiring attribution and share-alike.

language.description: Primary language in which the resource is written or presented.
